chains.outcome: All 3 DPA envelopes live in DocuSign, the obligation register updated in Excel and Confluence, and Elena Vasquez notified in Teams — LGL-1027 unblocked before the September renewals

insight.headline: 3 of Ariba's 30 July renewals carried $612K of spend with no executed DPA on file
insight.detail: Joining Ariba's renewal calendar against DocuSign's executed-agreement archive exposed vendors renewing in September with no data-processing terms — a GDPR audit finding waiting to happen. Ariba only sees spend and dates, DocuSign only sees envelopes; neither alone can tell you a renewal is about to re-up a compliance gap.
insight.action: Add a DPA-on-file check to the Ariba renewal intake gate so the gap never recurs

insight.headline: Only 3 of Orion's 18 redlines are material, and the $1.24M blocker is a sign-off, not a fight
insight.detail: Overlaying DocuSign's redline diff on the GDrive playbook and Marcus's Outlook thread showed the 2x cap Orion 'won't move off' is already permitted with GC approval — turning a stalled negotiation into a routing task. The redline tool sees edits, the playbook sees policy, email sees urgency; only joined do they reveal the deal was never actually stuck.
insight.action: Pre-wire playbook lookups into every MSA redline pass so exceptions route the moment they appear
